description: Transport paths, stable Tailscale service traffic, physical interfaces and Loem's public ingress and Git service activity.

panels.description: 1 means the Tailscale metrics endpoint can be scraped. This checks telemetry availability, not end-to-end reachability of every service. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Tailscale exporter

panels.description: Current warnings reported by tailscaled. This is a live gauge, not a count of past warnings. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Tailscale health warnings

panels.description: Share of receive bytes through DERP or a peer relay. Direct IPv4/IPv6 is usually faster. Idle hosts show zero; relaying alone is not a failure. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Relayed receive traffic

panels.description: Traffic entering stable Tailscale services such as Git SSH and VictoriaMetrics. Includes only tailscale serve, not requests through Cloudflare. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Served ingress
Tailnet transport paths and stable services

panels.description: Separate direct IPv4/IPv6, DERP and peer relay paths. A path change can explain a throughput or latency change.
panels.title: Tailnet receive traffic by path

panels.description: Outgoing encrypted network traffic by tailscaled transport path.
panels.title: Tailnet transmit traffic by path

panels.description: Incoming traffic grouped by Tailscale service identity. VictoriaMetrics retains its service name when the backend moves to a different device.
panels.title: Service ingress

panels.description: Outgoing responses from Tailscale serve services; does not include Caddy or Cloudflare ingress.
panels.title: Service egress

panels.description: Drops per second by reason. Multicast and unsupported protocols may be intentionally dropped; compare error rates with traffic instead of alarming on lifetime totals.
panels.title: Tailnet dropped packets

panels.description: Receive and transmit throughput for host interfaces, including tailscale0. Container bridges and ephemeral veth pairs are excluded.
panels.title: Physical and tailnet interfaces

panels.description: Percentage of outgoing TCP segments retransmitted across the host. This is a host-wide congestion/loss clue, not specific to Tailscale.
panels.title: TCP retransmissions

panels.description: Current interface error and drop rates. Filtered to the same physical/tailnet interfaces as throughput.
panels.title: Interface errors and drops
Loem public ingress · Cloudflare and Caddy

panels.description: Concurrent healthy tunnel connections to Cloudflare. Four is the normal default. Collected by the cloudflared self-scrape after the Loem metrics configuration is activated.
panels.title: Cloudflare tunnel connections

panels.description: Incoming tunnel request rate and requests that failed to proxy to the origin. Both counters are converted to current rates. Requires the cloudflared self-scrape.
panels.title: Cloudflare requests and origin errors

panels.description: Origin responses by HTTP status. Distinguish client 4xx requests from server 5xx failures; this measures the shared tunnel, not individual application routes. Requires the cloudflared self-scrape.
panels.title: Cloudflare response codes

panels.description: Last configuration reload success and reverse-proxy health bookkeeping; one is the healthy state. Upstream health is not an active end-to-end probe when active checks are not configured. Dynamic placeholder upstreams are excluded. Requires the Caddy self-scrape.
panels.title: Caddy configuration and upstream state

panels.description: Git upload-pack operations per repository. This is SSH Git activity from Soft Serve, not Forgejo web/API activity. Requires the Soft Serve self-scrape.
panels.title: Git fetch/clone requests

panels.description: Average seconds spent serving each upload-pack operation. A missing series means no operations in the interval; it is not a zero-latency measurement. Requires the Soft Serve self-scrape.
panels.title: Git upload-pack average duration
